description: The other half of theme-css-halves: the saved OML has to bring the three halves coherent. The base is the previous job itself (the runner rebuilds, saves and reloads), and the get is over the module reloaded from disk. Without the kernel fix the effective one stayed frozen and the delivered module would carry a CSS that contradicts its own parts -- invisible until publishing. The values are checked in Anvil.Tests.Odc.ThemeCssTests.

ops._why: after saving and reloading: UserStyleSheet is the text of the previous job and StyleSheet is generated + CRLF + that text
